text:
samir: Noticing invoice preview totals spike for a handful of tenants overnight. Root cause looks like late-arriving session-end events that arrive after preview window and then get folded into final, but previews sometimes already included in-flight partial sessions leading to double-counting. tenant example: t-812.

mia: this smells like the sessionization change we rolled last week (session-tombstone TTL shortened). previews use approximate session joins to be fast. Did we change when we emit a session_end marker?

jordan: I dug into the ingest logs for shard-7. Found events with same session_id that have timestamps out-of-order by up to 5m. Preview aggregator was counting tokens for open sessions then final aggregator deduped and merged them differently.

clare: consequence is preview > final in some windows, but the reverse also happens when late events bump final higher. Billing ops confused. We need two things: make preview conservative about open sessions OR tag previews with "open-session-coverage" so ops knows to expect variance.

eng-metering-bot: detection: session-reordering-rate increased on ingest-proxy from 0.2% -> 3.7% between 2026-03-13T02:00Z and 2026-03-13T03:00Z (shard-7).

jordan: query I ran to see reorders:
```
SELECT session_id, count(*) as cnt, min(ts) as first_ts, max(ts) as last_ts
FROM raw_stream_events
WHERE tenant='t-812' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-13T00:00Z' AND '2026-03-13T04:00Z'
GROUP BY session_id HAVING max(ts)-min(ts) > interval '00:02:00';
```
returns ~4.5k sessions.

mia: options: 1) preview: switch to session-stable mode (close sessions with 2m buffer) — less noisy but increases preview tail; 2) keep fast preview but add UI flag and metric for "open_session_fraction" so ops can see expected variance; 3) backfill reorder-corrected events for affected invoices (costly).

samir: prefer smaller blast radius change first. Implement UI badge + metric and adjust preview aggregation to tag any counts coming from sessions with last_event_age > 30s as "partial". Then evaluate whether to widen buffer.

clare: I'll mock a badge in the invoice preview that says: "partial sessions present - totals may be provisional" and a toggle: "Hide partial sessions". Also will add a line in the invoice preview breakdown showing open_session_fraction as percentage.

jordan: I'll add the tag in preview aggregator and emit telemetry: preview_session_partial_count, preview_session_partial_token_share. Gate under feature-flag `preview_partial_session_tag`. Will open PR.

eng-metering-bot: ticket created automatically: BILL-2224 (preview-partial-sessions-metric).

mia: putting together a runbook: if partial_session_fraction > 1% sustained for 1h, page eng-platform and billing-ops. Drafting cost estimates for wider backfill if needed.

samir: owners: jordan -> preview tagging + telemetry PR, clare -> console badge + toggle mock, mia -> runbook + backfill cost estimate, samir -> SLA/alert threshold decisions.

jordan: PR #4201 opened, includes tests and canary plan. Canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-13T09:00Z.

clare: figma: https://figma.com/file/partial-sessions-mock (v1). Adding explanatory copy: "Preview may include events from sessions that haven't closed yet. Use 'Hide partial sessions' to see conservative totals."

mia: filing ticket for finance approval for potential backfill: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-2225. estimate $900 compute + ops time.

samir: ok. add alert: preview_to_final_session_delta_pct > 0.8% for 30m -> create an incident-only slack channel and post a short summary to billing-ops.

release-bot: scheduled: canary deploy PR #4201 to preview-cluster at 2026-03-13T09:00Z.

samir: thanks team. After canary, please post results and whether we should widen session close buffer or keep the tagging UX. :thumbsup:
